en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European apartment or hotel facade with bay windows, decorative stucco and wrought‑iron balconies. A man stands on one balcony. At street level there are shopfronts, including a men's fashion store, and benches along a wide, unpaved or lightly paved roadway. The architectural style is historicist with Art Nouveau elements.
